title: net.nat_traversal_outcome
description: M8B § Acceptance 'ICE-lite + STUN punches a symmetric-NAT to symmetric-NAT pair' + 'TURN relay engages when ICE-lite fails'. Emitted by the server (and surfaced to the client's status line) when the NAT punch-through flow resolves. NOT cosmetic (status of the session's connectivity tier is sim-relevant).

method.description: Which traversal flow succeeded. ICE-lite = STUN-discovered candidate pair; TURN relay = relayed allocation.

path.description: User-visible tier label surfaced in the status line.

elapsed_ms.description: Total wall-clock time spent in the NAT punch flow. Target ≤ 6000 ms per spec § Acceptance.
